title: Design option bindings
responsibility: Write design alternatives and resolve the exact image bindings belonging to each option.

inputs.name: planOptions.input
inputs.description: Design input with either an images array, used only when options is absent, or 1 to 10 options, each with a non-empty direction of at most 2000 characters and a non-empty images array. Directions must be distinct after trimming and lowercasing, no image may appear in more than one option, and flat images given beside options must match the combined option images in state, viewport and content.

inputs.name: planOptions.base
inputs.description: Repository path prefix of the version's design folder, such as src/components/evidence-grid/designs/v002. Each option's prompt is stored in files under base followed by /oN-prompt.md, and nothing is written for an option without a prompt.

inputs.name: planOptions.files
inputs.description: Mutable map from repository path to file content, to which each option's prompt text is assigned in place under base/oN-prompt.md; existing entries are not removed.

examples.src/components/evidence-grid/designs/v00: Card grid with inline source previews.

inputs.name: planOptions.write
inputs.description: Image writer called with the images and a filename prefix, returning the stored DesignImage metadata for them. planOptions passes an empty prefix for a single design and oN- for each option's images.

inputs.name: heldBy.version
inputs.description: Stored design version whose options are searched for the option holding the file; a version without options has no owner.

inputs.name: approvable.option
inputs.description: Option ID to approve, such as o1; an optioned version needs one, and an omitted or unmatched ID yields null. A single design must leave it out, because any ID yields null.

outputs.name: planOptions
outputs.description: The written images of the design: for options, all option images combined, with options listing each DesignOption's prompt, revised prompt, generator and image bindings; a single design returns images alone.

outputs.name: checkOptions
outputs.description: Returns nothing: it returns normally when the version has no options, or when its stored options claim each version image exactly once, with matching sha256, in-order ids, and valid directions, revised prompts, generators and prompt file names; otherwise it throws.

outputs.name: optionOf
outputs.description: Owning option ID, such as o2, when an option of the version holds the file; undefined for a single design or when no option holds the file.

outputs.name: heldBy
outputs.description: Object whose option field is the owning option ID when one holds the file, and an empty object when none does.

outputs.name: approvable
outputs.description: The file and sha256 bindings to approve: the chosen option's images or every image of a single design, or null when the option selection does not match the version.

errors.name: PlanningFailure
errors.description: The planning fail helper throws a plain Error whose code is invalid-input for rejected input or text, not-found when heldBy refuses a wanted option that does not own the file, artifact-tampered when stored options do not match the version images, or unsafe-path for an invalid stored prompt file name.

outputs.name: id

outputs.name: provenance

errors.name: PlanningFailure
errors.description: Raised with code invalid-input when the provider or the model is not non-empty text.
